subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Contextualizar, comparar e avaliar os impactos de diferentes modelos socioeconômicos no uso dos recursos naturais e na promoção da sustentabilidade econômica e socioambiental do planeta (como a adoção dos sistemas da agrobiodiversidade e agroflorestal por diferentes comunidades, entre outros).

components.description_pt: Comparar modelos socioeconômicos com base em seu uso de recursos naturais e impacto ambiental
components.description_en: Compare socioeconomic models based on their use of natural resources and environmental impact
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate human resource management practices based on their impact on biodiversity and sustainability

components.description_pt: Avaliar resultados de sustentabilidade de sistemas de agrobiodiversidade e agrofloresta adotados por diferentes comunidades
components.description_en: Evaluate the sustainability outcomes of agrobiodiversity and agroforestry systems adopted by different communities
components.cc_component_description: Explain why biodiversity is essential to the sustainability of human societies

components.description_pt: Contextualizar como diferentes modelos econômicos promovem ou prejudicam a sustentabilidade socioambiental
components.description_en: Contextualize how different economic models promote or undermine socio-environmental sustainability

components.description_pt: Analisar a relação entre modos de produção e sustentabilidade ecológica de longo prazo em escalas local e global
components.description_en: Analyze the relationship between modes of production and long-term ecological sustainability at local and global scales
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between human population growth and increased consumption of natural resources

cc_matches.description: The sustainability of human societies and the biodiversity that supports them requires responsible management of natural resources.
Typically as human populations and per-capita consumption of natural resources increase, so do the negative impacts on Earth unless the activities and technologies involved are engineered otherwise.
